label: Form 1040 Exception 1 component assertions and checked Schedule-D conclusion for tax year 2025 (ADR-0050)

fact_types.title: Exception 1 component C1 (ADR-0050): whether the return's only capital gains are Form 1099-DIV box-2a capital-gain distributions and the filer had no 2025 sale of stock, bonds, funds or other property that must be reported on Form 8949 or Schedule D, including one with no gain or loss; sales inside an IRA or 401(k) and losses on personal-use property do not count (Form 1040 instructions, line 7a: "If you sold a capital asset ... you must complete and attach Form 8949 and Schedule D"; Schedule D instructions, Capital Assets Held for Personal Use: "Loss from the sale or exchange of a capital asset held for personal use isn't deductible"). Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C2 (ADR-0050): whether the return has no capital losses. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C3 (ADR-0050): whether no capital gain is being deferred through a qualified opportunity fund. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C4 (ADR-0050): whether no Form 1099-DIV or substitute statement has an amount in box 2b, 2c, or 2d. Return-level contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Not a source-family claim and creates no member, family, closure, mapping, or collection path for boxes 2b/2c/2d. Distinct from box-2a family closure and from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Checked Schedule-D-required conclusion for the direct line-7a route (ADR-0050 Decision 1): domain {yes, no}. Published only from the accepted binding over C1-C4 (all present and yes -> no; all present and any no -> yes; any missing -> unpublished blocked DEPENDENCY_ABSENT naming every missing component). Not the historical contributed tax.us.2025.schedule-d-required fact type, which remains immutable history and is not direct-route authority in the successor graph.
